{{Quote|A local addict known as Menchi Lerann has been helpful with CorSec agents in the past.|[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope|Cope]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFRSM" />}}
'''Menchi Lerann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] addict who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Wassat? You need somethin' from Menchi? Menchi likes to help CorSec. What can Menchi do?|Menchi Lerann, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CCFRSM" />}}
Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], Menchi Lerann resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]]. Lerann was addicted to [[Ryll/Legends|ryll spice]] and was an informant for the [[Corellian Security Force]].<ref name="SWG:CCFRSM" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Menchi helped provide the location of his ryll suppliers, [[Jaylon Geissler]] and [[Vuul Sarlin]], to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Lon Cope|Cope]] of the CorSec.<ref name="SWG:CCFRSM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Menchi Lerann was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CCFRSM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Menchi Lerann was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
